title: private-deployments-weekly-2026-03-09
content:
Private Deployments — Engineering Weekly
Week: 2026-03-02 -> 2026-03-08
Owner: Aisha Patel
Status: in_review

Summary
- Busy week with three active customer installs (two VPC, one on-prem).
- Major focus: unblock Customer A (networking) and Customer B (HSM/KMS integration).
- Several infra improvements merged to make installs more deterministic (see PD-421).
- Planning: ramp install automation next week (install-as-code prototype).

Highlights / Wins
- Automated preflight checks landed (PR #732) — reduces manual network triage by ~30m per install.
- On-prem install for Customer C completed (staging -> prod) after iterative packaging fixes.
- Canary rollout for VPC routing policy update succeeded (no visible latency regressions).

Active Installs & Customer Blockers
1) Customer A (Large Fintech) — VPC private deployment
   - Blocker: customer-managed NAT gateway asymmetry (some nodes cannot reach KMS endpoint).
   - Impact: install stuck at config sync step; cannot complete final cert provisioning.
   - Action taken: SRE (Ethan) opened ticket with their networking team; provided tcpdump + traceroutes.
   - Next step: propose temporary broker proxy to allow cert fetch; longer term: update preflight to catch this in earlier phase (owner: Michael).
   - Jira: PD-437 (networking edge cases)

2) Customer B (Healthcare) — Private (on-prem with HSM)
   - Blocker: HSM vendor SDK throws intermittent error on signing requests under load.
   - Impact: key rotation tests failing; delaying go-live to next week unless resolved.
   - Action taken: engaged vendor support; provided logs and stress test harness. Priya created a reduced repro; vendor acknowledged a firmware edge case.
   - Temporary mitigation: fallback to software signing for non-critical services; KMS/rotation will be gated.
   - Owner: Priya Nair.

3) Customer C (Retail) — On-prem air-gapped
   - Status: install completed. Follow-up: retention policy audit and local metrics ingestion tuning.
   - Minor follow-ups: update docs for firewall rules (added note for outbound DNS requirement).

Engineering Work / PRs
- PR #732: preflight-checks: add NAT/NAT-symmetry checks and KMS reachability probes — merged (Michael).
- PR #741: installer: resiliency for partial config apply (resume logic) — in_review (Aisha).
- PR #745: packaging: include vendor HSM shim and diagnostics (Priya) — merged.
- Infra change: routing policy alpha -> canary (no rollback) — deployed to two regions; monitor dashboard.

Standup Logs (high-level notes)
Mon 2026-03-02
- Aisha: focus on installer resume logic; blocked on test harness flakiness.
- Michael: prepping preflight PR for NAT checks.
- Priya: working on HSM repro; vendor engaged.
- Ethan: networking triage for Customer A; scheduled call Tue 10am with customer networking.

Tue 2026-03-03
- Aisha: fixed race in installer was root cause of resume flakiness; running end-to-end.
- Michael: preflight PR + unit tests; beginning integration test with mock KMS.
- Priya: vendor reproduces firmware case; recommended firmware upgrade but need customer's maintenance window.
- Ethan: triage call with Customer A; discovered NAT asymmetry due to cross-account route table config.

Wed 2026-03-04
- All-hands with sales/solutions to align go-live expectations for Customer B.
- Decided to offer temporary software-signing fallback to unblock UAT.
- Installer PR #741 opened for review.

Thu 2026-03-05
- Michael: merged preflight checks; noticed one false-positive; follow-up to tighten probe.
- Priya: validated vendor patch on internal env; patch reduces error rate but not full fix.
- Aisha: created smoke tests for on-prem packaging.

Fri 2026-03-06
- Customer C completed install in morning. Retro: packaging script missed one symlink on RHEL 7 — patched.
- Planning session for install-as-code: scope minimal viable feature set for next sprint.

Meetings / Decisions
- 2026-03-03 10:00AM — Networking triage (Customer A)
  - Attendees: Ethan, Michael, Customer-A-neteng
  - Decision: implement short-term broker proxy; schedule architecture review for permanent fix.
  - Owner: Michael (broker POC), ETA 2026-03-12 for POC.

- 2026-03-04 2:00PM — Sales + Eng go-live alignment (Customer B)
  - Decision: enable software-signing fallback under feature flag to allow UAT.
  - Owner: Priya (feature flag + docs), ETA 2026-03-08 (delivered but gated by customer window).

Risks / Notes
- HSM vendor fix timeline uncertain -> could push Customer B go-live by 1–2 sprints. Contingency: plan for temporary hybrid key management mode.
- NAT asymmetry case hints at more customers with complex cross-account networking -> add to preflight backlog to avoid repeated triage.
- Installer resume logic still needs more e2e coverage (flaky tests causing slow CI feedback).

Action Items (owners & ETA)
- Michael: implement broker proxy POC for Customer A (PD-437) — ETA 2026-03-12.
- Priya: ship feature-flagged software-signing fallback + docs for Customer B — ETA 2026-03-08 (done, gated).
- Aisha: finish installer resume logic PR #741 and stabilize tests — ETA 2026-03-11.
- Ethan: add NAT asymmetry case to preflight backlog + create test vector — ETA 2026-03-13.
- Team: sketch install-as-code MVP + RFC for next sprint — draft by 2026-03-16 (owner: Aisha).

Notes / Misc
- Shared snippets: tcpdump/traceroute commands used for Customer A added to shared drive folder.
- Please add any customer-facing email drafts to linked_artifacts before sending.
- Postmortem: if HSM vendor fix rolls back go-live, we will run a mini-postmortem and update runbook.

Questions for leadership
- Approval to prioritize install-as-code work in next sprint (need 2 engineer-weeks).
- Temporary budget approval for vendor-assisted upgrade window (Customer B) if vendor requires on-site assistance.

Appendix: Relevant links
- Confluence runbook: confluence:redwood-private-deployments-runbook
- Jira tickets: PD-421 (preflight), PD-437 (Customer A networking), PD-444 (HSM edge case)
- Slack thread: #private-deployments: "Customer B HSM reproducer"

--
Notes are working-doc style (informal). Keep updating throughout week.
